Wait, the rule says "Queens may not touch, including diagonally." This is the standard "no touching" constraint often found in puzzles like this. Thus queens in consecutive rows cannot occupy columns differing by 1." This confirms the standard non-attacking constraint for adjacent rows, but specifically forbids touching. It also says "Queens separated by more than one row MAY share a long diagonal". This is a crucial distinction from standard N-Queens. Standard N-Queens forbids *any* diagonal sharing.
